sources.title: Nimbz/Gemma-4-Gembrain-31B-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: 🧠 About The Model Gembrain-31B is a synthesis of several models, including Gemsicle-31B as important ingredient. The goal of this release was to stabilize and improve the initial Gemsicle-31B, but also to enhance its logical and lateral thinking, both with and without reasoning.
